subject.title: fix(amazon-bedrock-mantle): dedupe the IAM token-failure diagnostic per region (#67288)

question: Should Bedrock Mantle IAM failures log only once per region until success or restart, or periodically repeat while failures continue?
rationale: Both policies eliminate per-request spam, but they make different operator-observability tradeoffs that tests cannot resolve without owner intent.

options.title: Accept first-failure visibility
options.body: Land one diagnostic per region until success or restart, preserving every IAM retry while eliminating unbounded catalog-refresh noise.

options.title: Use bounded reminder logging
options.body: Replace process-lifetime suppression with a fixed time-bounded limiter so continuing or changed failure details periodically reappear.

recommendation.title: Accept first-failure visibility
recommendation.body: Land one diagnostic per region until success or restart, preserving every IAM retry while eliminating unbounded catalog-refresh noise.

likelyOwner.reason: The IAM token-generation and runtime-refresh design appears to originate from wirjo's merged work on this provider.
